name: Chat Agent Workflow
description: Handles chat messages from the mobile app and provides AI responses

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.description: Receives chat messages from the mobile app

nodes.name: Format Context
nodes.description: Format the conversation history for AI

values.content: You are a helpful AI assistant. Continue the conversation naturally based on the context provided.

nodes.name: Save to Supabase
nodes.description: Save AI response back to Supabase

nodes.name: Response
nodes.description: Send response back to mobile app

supabaseConfig.note: You'll need to add your Supabase service key for server-side operations

setup: 1. Import this workflow into your n8n instance
2. Configure the Supabase node with your service key
3. Configure the OpenAI node with your API key
4. Update the webhook URL in your mobile app's chatService.ts
5. Test the workflow with a sample payload
